description: Discover populated categories and GitHub topics, repository counts and canonical /c/ URLs. An unbounded request retains the complete catalog for compatibility; use limit/offset for tool calls.

limit.description: Maximum results; omitted returns the remaining complete catalog.

offset.description: Zero-based offset; use next_offset/next from the response. Narrow the query if truncated=true.

q.description: Case-insensitive substring of a title or slug.

name: list_categories

as_of.description: Data-derived observation time or ranking week_start; null if unavailable. Individual repositories can have different freshness.

title: Category and topic directory
